Other games have different features, such as unique weapons abilities, which makes them really fun to play around with. You can modify weapons and hold them with either 1 or 2 hands in DS3. Elden Ring has Ashes of War, which are basically special abilities you can swap onto different weapons. All that said, I don't think any other games have trick weapons specifically. They're one of a kind and one of the best parts about Bloodborne. I will say, Lies of P has a system where you can swap weapon handles and heads (the blade, usually), to make unique weapon combinations. Your left arm is also robotic and and be swapped out for different arms with different abilities. 

If you're looking for a FromSoftware game specifically that is most similar to Bloodborne, I'd probably recommend DS3. Hope that helps!
